news.headline: NeurAxis Overhauls Executive Equity Compensation With Stock Option Exchange, New RSU Grants
news.summary: A previously shareholder-approved exchange of 1,319,394 outstanding stock options for RSUs became effective July 24, 2026, with CEO Brian Carrico, CMO Adrian Miranda and CRO Thomas Carrico among recipients; on August 13 the company also granted new three-year-vesting RSUs to the CEO, CFO Timothy Henrichs and other executives, plus one-time equity awards totaling 127,120 shares to independent directors.

news.headline: NeurAxis Earnings Call Signals High Growth, High Hurdles
news.summary: Post-earnings analysis noted NeurAxis gained traction with two large commercial payers and began early activity in the Veterans Affairs market, while adding a dedicated VP of Healthcare Economics and Policy; management said it is prioritizing revenue growth over near-term profitability and expects H2 2026 spending to rise, with no firm timeline yet for cash-flow breakeven.

news.headline: NRXS Stock Dips Post Q2 Earnings Despite Revenue Surge, Gross Margin Up
news.summary: Shares fell roughly 7-9% after NeurAxis reported a wider-than-expected Q2 2026 loss of $0.19/share (vs. -$0.16 forecast) even as revenue jumped 116% year-over-year to $1.928M and gross margin improved to 85.9%.

news.headline: NeurAxis Reports Record Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results Driven by 116% Year Over Year Revenue Growth
news.summary: NeurAxis posted its strongest quarter to date, with Q2 2026 revenue of $1.9M (up 116% YoY) driven by expanded payer coverage tied to the new Category I CPT code for PENFS that took effect January 1, 2026.

news.headline: NeurAxis Expands Payer Coverage with New Policies
news.summary: NeurAxis announced additional medical policy coverage for its IB-Stim PENFS therapy from regional health plans in the Mid-Atlantic region, extending reimbursement access to over 500,000 additional covered lives; CEO Brian Carrico said the win "broadens patient access and strengthens our reimbursement network."

news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on Tuesday, August 11, 2026
news.summary: NeurAxis announced it would release Q2 2026 financial results before market open on August 11, 2026, followed by a conference call at 9:00 a.m. ET.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings & business update call
catalysts.detail: No date announced yet as of September 5, 2026; based on the prior-year cadence (Q3 2025 call was hosted Nov 11, 2025) a similar November timing is likely for Q3 2026 results.

catalysts.label: Adult IBS/functional abdominal pain pivotal trial readout
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis is running a randomized, double-blind study of PENFS in adult IBS/FAP at Cleveland Clinic and Stanford; management has guided to usable data in roughly one to two years, which could support an adult-indication expansion into an estimated $14B additional addressable market.

catalysts.label: Additional national payer coverage decisions
catalysts.detail: Company disclosed active engagement with two large commercial payers and newly hired a VP of Healthcare Economics and Policy dedicated to payer advocacy; further medical-policy coverage wins (beyond the August 4 Mid-Atlantic policies) are expected to keep expanding the insured population for IB-Stim/PENFS.

catalysts.label: Path to cash-flow breakeven
catalysts.detail: On the Q2 2026 call management reiterated confidence in eventually reaching cash-flow breakeven while prioritizing revenue growth, but gave no specific timeline; H2 2026 spending is expected to rise as the company invests in commercial expansion.

pulse: NeurAxis remains a thinly-covered, high-growth microcap trading around $5.95-$6.10 in early September 2026, roughly flat since its early-August earnings print. Q2 2026 revenue more than doubled year-over-year (+116% to $1.93M) on the back of the new Category I CPT reimbursement code and fresh Mid-Atlantic payer coverage covering 500,000+ additional lives, but shares sold off after the print on a wider-than-expected EPS loss and no clear breakeven timeline; management has since finished converting 1.3M legacy stock options into RSUs and issued fresh multi-year equity grants to executives and directors. No new operational news has emerged since the August 19 compensation 8-K - the company is quiet heading into the fall, with the next hard catalyst being the Q3 2026 earnings call, expected around November based on last year's cadence but not yet officially scheduled, alongside ongoing efforts to land additional national payer coverage and progress the Cleveland Clinic/Stanford adult IBS pivotal study.
